MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of November 1, 2026 (the "Effective Date"), by and between Acme Corporation, a Delaware corporation having its principal place of business at 100 Enterprise Way, Suite 400, Wilmington, DE 19801 ("Client"), and CloudTech Solutions Inc., a California corporation having its principal place of business at 500 Silicon Vista, San Francisco, CA 94107 ("Provider"). Client and Provider may collectively be referred to as the "Parties" or individually as a "Party."

RECITALS
WHEREAS, Provider specializes in cloud infrastructure architecture and enterprise software maintenance; and
WHEREAS, Client desires to retain Provider to perform certain professional technical services, and Provider agrees to perform such services, pursuant to the terms and conditions set forth herein.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants contained herein, the Parties agree as follows:

SECTION 1. DEFINITIONS
1.1 "Affiliate" means any entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a Party.
1.2 "Confidential Information" means all non-public, proprietary information disclosed by either Party to the other Party.
1.3 "Deliverables" means all software code, documentation, work product, and reports developed by Provider for Client.
1.4 "Services" means the professional cloud consulting and engineering services described in Exhibit A.
1.5 "Term" means the duration of this Agreement as set forth in Section 4.1.

SECTION 2. SERVICES AND STATEMENTS OF WORK
2.1 Performance of Services. Provider shall perform the Services in accordance with the specifications in Exhibit A.
2.2 Standard of Care. Provider shall perform all Services in a professional, workmanlike manner consistent with prevailing industry standards.
2.3 Client Cooperation. Client shall provide Provider with reasonable and timely access to Client facilities, systems, and personnel.

SECTION 3. COMPENSATION AND PAYMENT TERMS
3.1 Professional Fees. Client shall pay Provider a fixed fee of One Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($150,000) for the initial phase of Services.
3.2 Invoicing. Provider shall submit monthly invoices to Client. Client must remit payment within thirty (30) days following receipt of each invoice.
3.3 Taxes. Client shall be responsible for all applicable sales, use, or value-added taxes, excluding taxes based on Provider's net income.

SECTION 4. TERM AND TERMINATION
4.1 Initial Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect until October 31, 2027 (the "Initial Term").
4.2 Termination for Convenience. Either Party may terminate this Agreement without cause upon providing sixty (60) days prior written notice to the other Party.
4.3 Termination for Cause. Either Party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other Party materially breaches any obligation and fails to cure such breach within thirty (30) days of receiving written notice.

SECTION 5. CONFIDENTIALITY
5.1 Protection of Information. Each Party shall hold the other Party's Confidential Information in strict confidence. Neither Party shall disclose Confidential Information to any third party without prior written consent.
5.2 Exclusions. Confidential Information shall not include information that is publicly known through no breach of this Agreement.

SECTION 6. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS
6.1 Ownership of Deliverables. Upon full payment of all fees due hereunder, Client shall own all right, title, and interest in and to the Deliverables.
6.2 Provider Pre-Existing IP. Provider retains exclusive ownership of all pre-existing software, frameworks, and tools used in connection with the Services.

SECTION 7. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES
7.1 Mutual Authority. Each Party represents and warrants that it has full corporate power and authority to enter into this Agreement.
7.2 Compliance with Laws. Both Parties must comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws in connection with their performance hereunder.

SECTION 8. INDEMNIFICATION
8.1 Provider Indemnity. Provider shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Client and its Affiliates against any third-party claim alleging that the Deliverables infringe any valid patent, copyright, or trademark.
8.2 Client Indemnity. Client shall defend and indemnify Provider against any third-party claim arising out of Client's unauthorized modification of the Deliverables.

SECTION 9. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
9.1 Consequential Damages Waiver. Except for breaches of Section 5 or indemnification obligations under Section 8, neither Party shall be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages.
9.2 Liability Cap. Each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be limited to Fifty Thousand Dollars ($50,000).

SECTION 10. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION
10.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
10.2 Arbitration. Any controversy arising under this Agreement shall be settled by binding arbitration in Wilmington, Delaware.

SECTION 11. GENERAL PROVISIONS
11.1 Severability. If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid, the remainder shall continue in full force.
11.2 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with Exhibit A and Exhibit B, constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties.

SECTION 12. EXECUTION
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties have executed this Master Services Agreement as of the Effective Date.

EXHIBIT A - SCOPE OF SERVICES
Provider shall provide continuous cloud migration, containerization, and 24/7 infrastructure monitoring services.

EXHIBIT B - SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT
Provider shall maintain a monthly system availability uptime of 99.9%.
